recipes.rule: Lead with one fact summary, then structured facts and source actions.
Use playlist cards for music; use news cards for other ranked entertainment results.
Use product rows with required name and optional image, price, rating, availability, seller, badge, and URL.
Use booking cards with row-local verified actions.
Use one forecast table; Android supplies hero, trend, and day cards.
Use only bar or column Chart backed by the same compact rows.
Use a schedule table for phases and a checklist only for actionable gates.
Use a checklist for tasks and status rows for progress.
Use a compact hero, ingredient table, and instruction tabs; never a detached gallery.
Compare locale-specific variants while preserving original values and units.
Use a diagnostic checklist/status flow and separate commands from output.
Present the work with minimal framing and no invented actions.
Use timeline cards from one compact schedule table.
Separate evidence, findings, limitations, and source actions; do not invent citations.
Use one feature matrix or entity table with a declared primary column.
Show the equation, variables, and numeric breakdown without renderer-generated conclusions.
Use one itinerary table with row-attached verified place media.
Use route/day rows with duration, stops, and row-local map actions.
Use a study schedule plus required learning checkpoints.
Keep prose concise; put APIs in tables and examples in code blocks.
Presentation is poster plus safe external open; never claim inline playback.
Show scanner readiness, result, and workflow states only; camera capture and recognition are out of scope.
Use one current-status alert and component status rows.
Use Alert with title, message, tone, timestamp, source, and child actions as available.
Use market/comparison rows and formulas; preserve values and avoid generated financial advice.
Presentation-only checklist with explicit source and disclaimer; never generate diagnosis, advice, or a conclusion.
Presentation-only document checklist with sources and disclaimer; never generate legal advice or conclusions.
Use property comparison rows with verified listing actions and product-style media.
Use an application checklist, role summary, and preview only when source content contains a draft.
Use restaurant cards with row-local menu, map, booking, and website actions.
Use provider booking/comparison rows and a scoped service checklist.
Use product/comparison rows for vehicles or parts and status checklist primitives for service workflows.
